description: Build a campaign on a connected Pinterest ad account. ALWAYS created PAUSED — worth knowing that Pinterest’s own API defaults new campaigns to ACTIVE, so this deliberately overrides that; it spends NOTHING until you activate it with set_pinterest_ads_status(confirm:true). Pinterest’s object graph is campaign -> ad group -> ad, and an ad PROMOTES AN EXISTING PIN, so a campaign ON ITS OWN CANNOT SERVE AN IMPRESSION: pass adGroup{name, targetingSpec, ad{pinId}} and this builds the whole tree. Pinterest has NO atomic multi-object write, so the levels are created in sequence and the campaign is ARCHIVED again if anything below it is rejected (Pinterest has no delete) — you never inherit a half-built campaign. Budgets are ordinary amounts in the ad account’s currency; the micro-currency conversion Pinterest requires is handled for you. Every ad group must target at least one place. Everything is READ BACK from Pinterest before you are told it exists; print the returned note verbatim, and if it says the campaign cannot serve yet, say that rather than calling it a finished ad.

adAccountId.description: Pinterest ad account id, from list_pinterest_ads_campaigns

adGroup.description: build the serving tree in the same call — WITHOUT this you get a campaign shell that can never show an ad

ad.description: the ad created in this ad group; promotes an existing Pin

pinId.description: the numeric id of an existing Pin — a Pinterest ad PROMOTES a Pin, so create one with post_to_pinterest first if there is nothing to promote

utm.description: UTM tags merged into destinationUrl as utm_source / utm_medium / utm_campaign / utm_term / utm_content — Pinterest has no UTM field of its own. Other query parameters and Pinterest macros like {campaignid} are kept

campaign.description: utm_campaign tag merged into destinationUrl; Pinterest has no UTM field

content.description: utm_content tag merged into destinationUrl; Pinterest has no UTM field

medium.description: utm_medium tag merged into destinationUrl; Pinterest has no UTM field

source.description: utm_source tag merged into destinationUrl; Pinterest has no UTM field

term.description: utm_term tag merged into destinationUrl; Pinterest has no UTM field

bid.description: REQUIRED — what you pay per billable event, in the ad account’s currency. Pinterest rejects an ad group without one and Hermoso will not invent a bid. It must also be BELOW the campaign budget and above Pinterest’s own bid floor for the placement, both of which Pinterest states in its refusal.

billableEvent.description: LEAVE THIS OUT unless you know better — Pinterest ties it to the campaign objective and refuses a mismatch: CONSIDERATION takes CLICKTHROUGH; AWARENESS, SALES, LEADS, WEB_CONVERSION, VIDEO_COMPLETION and APP_INSTALL take IMPRESSION; CATALOG_SALES takes either. Omitted -> the right one for the objective is used.

budget.description: ad-group budget — only valid when the campaign is NOT budget-optimized (Pinterest optimizes at campaign level by default)

placementGroup.description: where the ads run: ALL, SEARCH, BROWSE or OTHER

targetingSpec.description: Pinterest targeting object, e.g. {"GEO":["US"],"AGE_BUCKET":["25-34","35-44"]} — at least one GEO or LOCATION is REQUIRED by Pinterest. Age: use AGE_BUCKET, or MINIMUM_AGE and MAXIMUM_AGE TOGETHER (18–65, with "65+" allowed as the maximum) — a minimum on its own is refused.

bidOptions.description: Pinterest bid_options object: multipliers by age, gender, placement, audience or frequency

dailyBudget.description: daily cap in the ad account’s currency

intendedPromotionType.description: the kind of ads it will carry

isCampaignBudgetOptimization.description: default true at Pinterest: the budget sits on the campaign

isPerformancePlus.description: Pinterest Performance+ on this campaign; with no lifetime budget Pinterest also requires isFlexibleDailyBudgets:true

lifetimeBudget.description: lifetime cap instead of a daily one — Pinterest then requires endTime

objective.description: Pinterest requires an objective and will not guess one. CATALOG_SALES and WEB_CONVERSION are LEGACY: Pinterest disables creating them on 2027-02-01 — use SALES (with intendedPromotionType CATALOG for a shopping/catalog campaign) instead

name: create_pinterest_ads_campaign
title: Build a Pinterest ad campaign (paused)
